title: ComponentLabels
description: Output of the component-ID stage. Shared by the online (Gemini) and offline (YOLO) paths. Labels only: no geometry, no verdicts.

id.description: Part id assigned by grid mapping, e.g. R1, LED1. Must match a grid-map part.

value.description: Value in SI base units: ohms for resistors, volts for supplies, farads for capacitors. Null if not applicable or unreadable.

markings.description: Raw visible markings: color bands, chip text, LED color.

positive_leg.description: Index into the part's legs of the positive terminal: LED anode, supply +, electrolytic cap +. Null for non-polar parts.
